title: SWE-VERIFIER: Selective Verification for Cost-Efficient Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.30284v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents spend substantial computation generating actions and processing long interaction histories. Poor action choices can steer agents into low-value states, wasting computation and increasing API costs. Sampling and verifying alternative actions can improve the agent's decisions, but applying this procedure at every step adds substantial overhead. We introduce SWE-Verifier, a lightweight generative model that selectively triggers candidate sampling and verification. It scores the coding agent's proposed action to determine when additional candidate sampling is needed, then ranks the resulting actions before execution. We train SWE-Verifier from Qwen3.5-4B using preference data that groups contrasting actions with their resulting environment observations and rubric-guided teacher scores. Using the mini-swe-agent harness, SWE-Verifier improves resolution from 75.47% to 77.20% on MiniMax-M2.7 at 1.09 times cost and generalizes to D

translated_title: SWE-Verifier：面向高性价比编程智能体的选择性验证
translated_abstract: 编程智能体在生成动作和处理长交互历史时会消耗大量计算。糟糕的动作选择会使智能体进入低价值状态，浪费计算资源并增加API成本。采样并验证备选动作可以改善智能体的决策，但在每一步都执行该流程会带来大量额外开销。我们提出了SWE-Verifier，一个轻量级生成模型，可选择性地触发候选采样与验证。它对编程智能体提出的动作进行评分，以判断何时需要额外的候选采样，然后在执行前对生成的动作进行排序。我们使用偏好数据从Qwen3.5-4B训练SWE-Verifier，该数据将对比动作与其产生的环境观察结果以及基于评分标准的教师评分分组在一起。在mini-swe-agent框架下，SWE-Verifier以1.09倍的成本将MiniMax-M2.7的解决率从75.47%提升至77.20%，并能泛化到其他（模型）……
tldr: 提出轻量级生成模型SWE-Verifier，通过选择性触发候选动作采样与验证，以仅1.09倍的成本将编程智能体的解决率从75.47%提升至77.20%。
en_tdlr: SWE-Verifier, a lightweight generative model that selectively triggers candidate action sampling and verification, improves coding agents' resolution rate from 75.47% to 77.20% at only 1.09 times the cost.
